name: 한지영

appearance_en.face_shape: strong heart-shaped face, prominent angular cheekbones, narrow pointed chin — striking before it is conventionally pretty, the face that takes a moment and then cannot be forgotten
appearance_en.skin: warm medium-dark olive Korean skin, natural golden undertone, clear and luminous — the one person in the office who does not wear foundation and is the most memorable
appearance_en.eyes: single eyelid (monolid), deep-set dark eyes, long dense lashes, heavy-lidded and unhurried — the gaze that assesses completely before responding. When she has decided, every person in the room knows it. The eyes that read 형부's message and did not look away for three seconds
appearance_en.nose: straight slightly strong nose with defined bridge — anchors the face rather than disappearing into it
appearance_en.mouth: full well-shaped lips, naturally deeper-toned, slightly parted at rest — the mouth that says '그게 왜 당연해요?' quietly, which is what makes it devastating
appearance_en.eyebrows: thick natural dark brows, strong arch, not groomed into submission — the brow she grew into in her 30s. The most distinctive thing on her face when she is not speaking
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: small beauty mark at the left cheekbone just below the outer eye corner — appears in every panel. Angular cheekbones cast clean shadow beneath. The golden skin reads as warmth against corporate cool-tone environments
appearance_en.hair: sleek blunt collarbone-length dark bob, slight natural weight, worn down — architectural and deliberate. The one thing she has taken back from ten years of corporate convention

body.proportions: tall slim frame, defined shoulders, long legs — reads as authority before she speaks
body.posture: straight and unhurried, occupying exactly the space she occupies — not performing relaxation, not apologising for the height
body.body_prompt: 168cm tall slim Korean woman, defined angular shoulders, long legs, unhurried upright posture that takes up exactly its own space

default.description: fitted fine-knit turtleneck or clean structured open-collar shirt, tailored charcoal or black trousers — no blazer, no accessories except a single thin gold ring. Subtracts rather than adds
default.wardrobe_prompt: fitted fine-knit turtleneck or structured open-collar shirt, tailored charcoal or black trousers, no blazer, single thin gold ring

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: heavy-lidded and unhurried — always two moves ahead, no reason to announce it. The beauty mark catches the ink. The feeling about 형부 is present, unnamed, compositionally central
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 35-year-old Korean woman, strong heart-shaped face with prominent angular cheekbones and narrow chin, single eyelid deep-set dark eyes with long lashes and heavy-lidded gaze, thick natural strongly arched dark brows, straight defined-bridge nose, full naturally deeper lips slightly parted, small beauty mark at left cheekbone, sleek blunt collarbone-length dark bob, 168cm tall defined-shoulder slim frame, warm medium-dark olive Korean skin

style_prompt: Studio Ghibli heartwarming hand-painted watercolor art style, expressive monolid face with architectural bone structure and warm golden olive skin, modern corporate or urban setting contrasting warm skin against cool painted environment, cinematic dramatic backlighting casting deep cheekbone shadow, iridescent city light from glass surfaces, magical realism of a feeling not yet named, soft diffused warm light, Korean drama cinematic composition, monolid gaze rendered with unhurried weight and intent, beauty mark at cheekbone as compositional anchor
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, manga ink lines, screen tone, looking at camera, eye contact, facing camera, double eyelid, pale skin, soft round face, permed hair, open cheerful expression, glamorous, cute
